name: agent-manager-harness-state-machine
description: State and transition contract for Harness delivery run reports.
blockedDownstreamRule: A downstream task cannot be done while an ancestor task is awaiting_human or blocked.
resumeRule: A resumed task must include humanAnswer, decision, resumedAt, and resumeCriteriaSatisfied=true before downstream tasks continue.
completionRule: A task can be done only when all manifest dependencies are done or explicitly skipped with reason.
